title: tpu-sharding Request
description: Input payload for the tpu-sharding orchestrator agent.

prompt.description: High-level user instructions or shorthand specifications (e.g., 'ep=8, tp=2, bf16').

run_id.description: Session run identifier, assigned at session start and passed verbatim.

model_path.description: Filesystem path or repository URL to the model code.

related_metrics_to_track.description: Additional metrics to track during optimization.

optimization_constraints.description: Hard optimization constraints and bounds (e.g., 'Sequence length must be fixed at 2048.', 'batch_size between 64 and 256').

execution_timeout_seconds.description: Per-run execution timeout in seconds (default: 3600). Applies to each individual execution attempt, not total loop duration.

loop_budget_runs.description: Maximum number of optimization experiment runs/iterations (e.g., 5). Omit for indefinite exploration.

backend.description: Execution backend (e.g., 'k8s', 'slurm', 'local'). Inherited from environment if omitted.

gcp_project.description: Google Cloud project ID hosting compute resources.

cluster_cell.description: Cluster cell or resource allocation pool name.

examples.prompt: Optimize sharding for Qwen3.5-397B training on v6e_2x2x1 to maximize MFU.
examples.optimization_constraints: Sequence length must be fixed at 2048.
